# Real MediaPipe regression inputs

Official upstream test images: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/pose.jpg and https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/right_hands.jpg.
They are the fixtures named by Google's Apache-2.0 tests:
https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe/blob/master/mediapipe/tasks/python/test/vision/pose_landmarker_test.py
https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe/blob/master/mediapipe/tasks/python/test/vision/hand_landmarker_test.py

observed-results.json is generated by running the bundled, hash-pinned Pose/Hand models on these images in the actual offline browser worker, not by writing expected landmarks by hand.
To regenerate deliberately: set MIAO_RECORD_LANDMARKS=1 and run tests/e2e/body-worker.spec.mjs. Review the diff before committing.
The Node solver tests consume these recorded world coordinates and assert raw VRM bone endpoints.

The adjacent ifacialmocap-official.txt is the unchanged one-frame example from https://ifacialmocap.jimdofree.com/for-developer/ (retrieved 2026-09-29); names and values retain the official _L/_R format.
